name: Hikari no Tsukuru: XP
storyline:
Three hundred years ago, a legend marked the fate of the Mayab Archipelago: the heroes of old received the blessing of a primordial angel, who left a firm instruction for future generations. The kings were not meant to merely choose their most capable warriors... they had to send them on a quest to find the angel and prove whether they were truly worthy of bearing the sacred title.

In the present day, facing an impending threat looming over the islands, the king makes the decision to unify two legendary factions: the Xenith and the Paladins. As the chosen group, your mission is to embark on a perilous journey, face the formidable Quadrant, survive the overwhelming power of Gotran "The Blue Dragon", solve ancient puzzles, and prove you possess the courage required to become The Created by the Light.
